text.tspan: Procedure 2026/0011(COD). State as of 07 Oct 2026: steps done and in progress are marked. Upper part: the ordinary legislative procedure (Art. 294 TFEU); lower part: the act's procedure over time. Every event cites its source (see csa2.html).
ITRE committee stage: draft report 18 Sep 2026
Working party; no Council mandate yet
Act adopted in the wording of the EP
approves or no decision → adopted (7a); rejects
both adopt → adopted; otherwise not adopted
Informal: trilogues of EP, Council and Commission at every stage (Joint Declaration 2007, points 7–9); a trilogue agreement confirmed by Coreper and
offered by letter to the EP committee chair (point 14) leads to adoption at first reading, or, after the EP first reading, to an early second reading.

text.tspan: • Status as of 25 Sep 2026: first reading, committee stage in the EP; no Council mandate for negotiations (not public). No trilogue has taken place.
• The Directive amending NIS 2 (COM(2026) 13, procedure 2026/0012(COD)) is negotiated together with this Regulation in the Council (ST 9399/26 covers both).
• Several Member States asked the Council Legal Service to examine the legal basis (ST 9399/26, point 16).

Labels are shortened; the procedure page lists every event in full with its document and source. Sources: EP Open Data API (procedure events), Cellar procedure file, Council register documents and agendas, EUR-Lex. Our own compilation, not an official record.
